headline: Trout, tourism and clothing. Where Kyrgyzstan can create 67 thousand jobs
summary: Kyrgyzstan could attract up to $618 million in private investment and create up to 67,600 jobs across four sectors, including trout farming, tourism and clothing. The report was cited in a regional outlet.
why: Private investment in export-oriented and labour-intensive sectors shapes the growth outlook of smaller economies such as Kyrgyzstan.
original_headline: Форель, туризм и одежда. Где Кыргызстан может создать 67 тысяч рабочих мест
